title: Quenched Funky Clove Pilaf
description: A unique Croatian dish featuring ground cloves, dumplings, and a touch of cheese for an adventurous yet jain-friendly meal.
instructions: Rinse the rice and measure it into a pot with water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
In a separate pan, melt butter or oil over medium heat. Add ground cloves and cook for about 1 minute.
Add dumplings to the clove-infused oil mixture, stirring gently to coat them evenly.
Fold in the cooked rice, sprinkle grated cheese on top of the dumplings, and continue cooking until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot as a dinner side dish or main course.
